title: Ravenhill Reach regional resource centre opened
summary: The Department of Health reported that the Cedar Foundation Regional Resource Centre in South Belfast, known as Ravenhill Reach, was officially opened after comprehensive redevelopment as a regional and local services hub for people with disabilities.
source_name: New centre will help improve life for people with disabilities - Hamilton
